measures.name: drink_revenue
measures.expression: sum(case when is_drink_item then product_price else 0 end)

measures.name: drink_revenue_pct
measures.expression: sum(case when is_drink_item then product_price else 0 end) / nullif(sum(product_price), 0)

measures.name: food_revenue
measures.expression: sum(case when is_food_item then product_price else 0 end)

measures.name: food_revenue_pct
measures.expression: sum(case when is_food_item then product_price else 0 end) / nullif(sum(product_price), 0)
